en.title: Watermark · Tools SagalaIT
en.w02: Add a watermark to ID card photos or other important documents so they cannot be misused. Everything is processed in this browser: images are not uploaded and not saved.
en.w07: or click Choose images, or paste with Ctrl+V
en.w08: No image yet. This is a sample canvas to preview the watermark.
en.w12: Watermark text (can be more than one line)
en.w47: The downloaded image does not carry EXIF data from the original photo, such as GPS location and camera model.
en.wm_other: THIS DOCUMENT IS NOT VALID FOR ANY OTHER PURPOSE
en.empty_text: The text is empty, so there is no watermark. Write some text first to enable the download.
en.unreadable: {name} cannot be read by the browser (convert HEIC to JPG or PNG first)
en.no_image: No image yet. This is a sample canvas to preview the watermark.
en.no_webp: This browser cannot create WebP; the result is PNG.
en.fail_img: Could not create the image. Try a smaller "Longest side".
en.fail_zip: Could not create the ZIP. Try fewer or smaller images.
